---
name: Device support request
about: Ask for (or offer to help with) a new device
labels: device-support
---

**Device** (exact model + a USB VID:PID if you know it — Device Manager →
device → Details → Hardware Ids):


**Does OpenRGB support it?** (If yes, the bundled-OpenRGB bridge may already
cover you today — Settings → enable the OpenRGB bridge. Native support can
often be ported from OpenRGB's GPLv2 driver.)


**Can you test builds on this hardware?** Protocol work without hardware in
the loop is guesswork — a tester makes a driver possible.
